authorized_work: Read the six specified historical reports and verify code, environment, assets, traces, versions, SHA256 and live processes.
Run only arm A on public trace chain 0 with the official benchmark warmup and one main execution.
Independently audit the smoke and release all study-owned resources.

preflight.source_comparison: All 1297 tracked jitserve and vendored-vLLM files match among official commit, new study and old deployment.
preflight.network: offline model/tokenizer use; no dependency installation

execution_order: Start the official QRF socket predictor on CPU and wait for its listening state.
Start official jitserve.server through the observation-only native launcher on physical GPU2 and wait for /health.
Run the official DeepResearch benchmark main logic with chain 0; preserve warmup and main results separately.
Drain prediction callbacks, stop only registered process groups, and verify GPU2 memory release.
Evaluate the gate from raw client and server records after cleanup.

acceptance_gate.startup: QRF predictor and official server load successfully; /health succeeds; official client exits zero.
acceptance_gate.compound: Each of the warmup and main executions completes all 6 stages and 7 calls with per-stage request counts [1,2,1,1,1,1]; 14 total calls including warmup.
acceptance_gate.prediction: Every assigned call has submit, worker begin and eventual ready records; SequenceGroup assignment snapshots and at least one real COLLECTIVE allocation read are recorded.
acceptance_gate.graph: All 394 official training graphs load; every call has a finite online stage share; collection completion updates real graph state. Two finished graphs are expected after warmup plus main. Zero medoids is valid below the official 100-finished-graph clustering threshold and must not be misreported as formed clustering.
acceptance_gate.scheduler: The actual scheduler is SLOScheduler, official frame activity is observed, chunked prefill is enabled, and all admissions/preemptions/chunks are auditable.
acceptance_gate.metrics: Official main denominator is one collection, six stages and seven calls. Recomputed strict chain SLO and native SLO goodput match the official metrics. The independent whole-path denominator additionally retains the warmup execution.
acceptance_gate.provenance: All loaded JITServe/vLLM source paths are under the new-study official repo; source and asset manifests match.
acceptance_gate.cleanup: All study-owned predictor/server/client processes exit and only study-owned GPU2 memory is verified released; foreign processes are untouched.

interpretation: This is a qualification smoke only. It supplies no A/B/C performance conclusion, no algorithm advantage claim, and no evidence of real online-agent task quality.
failure_policy: Any unmet required gate leaves A unqualified. Preserve the attempt, diagnose within the frozen A-only budget, and stop without B/C if A cannot pass.
